method: Wikipedia HTML used only to discover main Wikidata identity; each canonical entity and its exact P625 statement read from Special:EntityData JSON without search APIs or retrying rate limits. Coordinates are exact copies of the selected structured statement, in longitude/latitude order. Current localities serve as documented place-centre references where only district/city-scale location is established; they do not establish exact historical footprints. Existing event approximate flags must remain.
licence: Wikidata structured data CC0. Supplementary text is cited/paraphrased only. No source images or other geometry reproduced.
